page_title: MAL 1-1 CAD | Mallorca v Cadiz CF 29/11/2023, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+7' David Gil makes a good save! Javier Llabres (Mallorca) easily weaves through the defence and unleashes a shot from long range. His effort is directed towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper is alert and stops it.
90+4' The free kick into the penalty area from Sergi Darder (Mallorca) is cleared.
90+4' Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva saw the whole situation. Mallorca have a free kick.
90+2' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the free kick but it's cleared.
90+2' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) trips an opposition player and Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a foul.
90' 7 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Mallorca can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

90' Good clearance! Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) received a low pass, but he didn't have time to do anything as one of the defenders quickly stole the ball off him. The ball goes out of play. Mallorca are awarded a corner kick.

89' Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear. The ball is behind the touchline and Mallorca will take a throw-in.

88' Toni Lato (Mallorca) cuts inside after a good run and goes for glory from the edge of the box. The shot, though, flies high over the bar into row Z. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
83' Substitution. Antonio Raillo will be replaced by Matija Nastasic (Mallorca).
83' Javier Aguirre has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Amath Ndiaye (Mallorca) replacing Daniel Rodriguez.
83' Martin Valjent (Mallorca) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
81' Mamadou Mbaye (Cadiz) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
80' Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.
78' Great individual play by Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) ends with a shot from distance that flies well wide of the left post.
76' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva who sees an offensive foul.
75' Substitution. Ivan Alejo makes his way off the pitch and Brian Ocampo (Cadiz) comes on as his replacement.
75' Sergio prepares a substitution. Roger Marti is replaced by Sergio Guardiola (Cadiz).
73' A player from Mallorca commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
72' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
71' Toni Lato (Mallorca) sends a long ball in, but David Gil comfortably gathers the ball. The ball is out of play and the linesman points at the corner flag. Corner to Mallorca.
69' Here is a change. Jose Copete is going off and Javier Aguirre gives the last tactical orders to Javier Llabres (Mallorca).
69' Jaume Costa just cannot continue due to injury and has to be substituted. Toni Lato (Mallorca) replaces him.
66' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) was quite harsh and Javier Iglesias Villanueva didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
64' Roger Marti (Cadiz) has tested the patience of referee Javier Iglesias Villanueva and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
64' Sergio has decided to make a change. Ruben Sobrino (Cadiz) replaces Maximiliano Gomez.
64' It's time for a substitution. Chris Ramos (Cadiz) comes on in place of Darwin Machis.

62' Predrag Rajkovic makes a brilliant save! Darwin Machis (Cadiz) easily weaves through the defence and fires the ball from mid-range. His low shot goes towards the middle of the goal but is saved by the keeper!
61' Wonderful pass from Cyle Larin (Mallorca) for Daniel Rodriguez, but they can't profit from it as David Gil comes off his line to collect.
60' One of the Cadiz CF players is in on goal but gets upended by the defender in the box. That could be a penalty, but the ref says NO! Play continues.
59' The substitution has been made. Giovanni Alessandro Gonzalez Apud (Mallorca) has replaced Pablo Maffeo.
57' Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) jumps into a tackle and Javier Iglesias Villanueva signals a foul. Mallorca are awarded a free kick.
57' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
57' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
54' Iza Carcelen has picked up an injury and is replaced by Joseba Zaldua (Cadiz).
52' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
51' Mallorca couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as David Gil (Cadiz) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
50' Foul! Ivan Alejo (Cadiz) is penalised for pulling back his opponent.
50' Cyle Larin receives a sweet cross inside the box from Pablo Maffeo (Mallorca), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
49' The cross into the penalty area from Darwin Machis (Cadiz) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team.
47' A player from Cadiz CF commits a rough challenge. Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+7' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.

45+6' What an opportunity that was! The ball rebounded out to Alex Fernandez (Cadiz), whose shot from the edge of the box goes a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Mallorca.
45+5' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is penalised for a foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva had a clear view and blows his whistle.
45+3' Rough tackle by Fali (Cadiz). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.

45+1' 1 - 1 Goal – 1:1! Pablo Maffeo sends a precise lofted pass into the box, Abdon Prats (Mallorca) rises above the defenders to meet the ball near the penalty spot and heads it straight into the left side of the goal.
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
44' Abdon Prats (Mallorca) sent a pass onto Cyle Larin, who didn't get a chance to finish. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
43' The free kick from long range, taken by Cadiz CF, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
42' Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight and sees a foul from Samu Costa (Mallorca).

41' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) wastes an opportunity to score with a header from inside the 18-yard box. His effort floats over the bar by a whisker! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
40' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
39' Lovely run from Cyle Larin (Mallorca). He finds himself one-on-one with the goalkeeper, lines up a shot, but the keeper boldly launches himself to intercept the ball.
36' The resulting set piece from Mallorca is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
36' Mallorca have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

36' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) latches on to a brilliant through ball in a promising position, but one of the defenders is alert to the danger and dispossess him. The ball goes out of play and Mallorca have been awarded a corner kick.
34' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Cyle Larin (Mallorca), but the defence gets it clear.

33' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.

32' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort. The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for Mallorca.
31' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
30' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) attempts to find one of his teammates with a sweet pass into the box, but one of the defending players reacts well and intercepts the effort.
29' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) commits a rough foul. Javier Iglesias Villanueva stops the game and makes a call.
28' Fali (Cadiz) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
26' Fali (Cadiz) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.

26' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception. The ball goes out of play and Cadiz CF will have a goal kick.
25' Jose Copete (Mallorca) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
25' The game is interrupted. Maximiliano Gomez (Cadiz) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
24' Daniel Rodriguez (Mallorca) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Javier Iglesias Villanueva has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
20' Javier Iglesias Villanueva interrupts the game. One of the players from Cadiz CF won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Mallorca will take a free kick.
20' The ball is whipped in from the corner by Abdon Prats (Mallorca), but one of the defenders gets it clear.
16' Mallorca quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
16' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Jaume Costa (Mallorca). The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Mallorca.

12' 0 - 1 Ruben Alcaraz (Cadiz) unleashes a beautiful rocket of a shot from a long-range free kick. The ball goes into the top right corner and leaves the goalkeeper beaten. This takes hours and hours on the training ground. The score is 0:1.
11' Jose Copete (Mallorca) makes a strong challenge and Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows for a foul. A free kick is awarded to Cadiz CF.
10' Cyle Larin (Mallorca) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
8' Roger Marti (Cadiz) makes an unfair challenge by holding his opponent to prevent him from getting the ball.
5' Great individual play by Cyle Larin (Mallorca) ends with a shot from distance that flies high over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Cadiz CF.
4' Javier Iglesias Villanueva blows his whistle and signals a foul after Jaume Costa (Mallorca) brought his opponent down.
3' Jaume Costa (Mallorca) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
3' Some great controlled play and passing from Mallorca. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Mallorca will take the kick-off.
Javier Iglesias Villanueva will supervise the game today.
